200292: Saki's step-brother and a second-year high school student. He became Saki's step-brother after his parents remarried. He is a normal high school student but is somewhat distant from others. He loves books to the level of a print addict.
204456: Saki's classmate. She's always cheerful and meddlesome, and when she can't stand to see Saki isolated, she gets annoyingly involved with her, and they become friends.
204457: Yuuta's classmate. He is almost Yuuta's only friend at school. He is also a member of the baseball team and an otaku.
204458: University student. She works part-time as a senior at the bookstore where Yuuta works. As a caring senior, she supports Yuuta's "relationship with his younger sister".
204459: Yuta's biological father and Saki's father-in-law. After divorcing his ex-wife for various reasons, he remarried Akiko Ayase. He has a good relationship with Yuta and Saki.
204460: Saki's biological mother and Yuuta's mother-in-law. After her divorce from her ex-husband, she worked tirelessly and raised Saki by herself until she remarried.
